config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the effect. Defaults to `Addressable Flicker`.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The time interval for updating the random offsets. Defaults to `16ms`.

config_entries.label: Intensity
config_entries.description: The intensity of the effect, basically how much the random values can offset the currently active light color. Defaults to `5%`.
